description: A shell script for retrieving version information from a source directory, supporting multiple version control systems such as version files, git, and hg.

methods.name: try_version
methods.description: Attempts to read version information from a local version file.

methods.name: try_git
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve version info from a git repository.

methods.name: try_hg
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve version info from a Mercurial repository.
